description: Strict-open BC tree-to-truck logging and truck-haul cost proxy using StatCan Open Licence tables, OGL-BC/OGL-Canada derived inputs, and CC-BY/public-domain machine-rate methods.
excluded_source_families: BC Interior Appraisal Manual (IAM) and Coast Appraisal Manual (CAM) - BC Crown copyright
TLA/ILA/NWLA/MNP Timber Harvest Cost Model Rate Guide - industry publisher copyright
FPInnovations/FERIC reports and case studies - publisher copyright
BC Wildfire Service (BCWS) rates - BC Crown copyright
Any other Crown-copyright PDF, proprietary dataset, or restricted microdata

sources.title: Explicit engineering assumptions of the strict-open BC cost model
sources.used_for: Capital prices, machine life, utilization, fuel burn, productivity cycle times, payload, and overhead assumptions.
sources.notes: Assumptions are not observations and are not BC empirical calibration.

sources.title: Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted (Table 18-10-0004-01)
sources.used_for: Converting 2021 and 2025 nominal wages to 2026 CAD; reporting the price base.

sources.title: Monthly average retail prices for gasoline and fuel oil, by geography (Table 18-10-0001-01)
sources.used_for: Diesel fuel price, Vancouver self-service, 12-month low/base/high range.
sources.notes: Retail pump price includes taxes; a conservative upper-bound fuel input.

sources.title: Employee wages by industry, annual (Table 14-10-0064-01)
sources.used_for: BC and Canada average hourly wage, forestry/fishing/mining/quarrying/oil and gas grouping.
sources.notes: Broad industry grouping; used as the upper wage anchor, not as a logging-specific rate.

sources.title: Employee wages by occupation, annual (Table 14-10-0417-01)
sources.used_for: BC lower wage anchor: natural-resource production occupations; truck/transport operator wage.
sources.notes: Broad occupational groups, not a logging-machine-operator survey.

sources.title: Logging industries, principal statistics by North American Industry Classification System (Table 16-10-0114-01)
sources.used_for: Canada logging production-worker wages and production-worker count, 2021, for the central wage anchor.
sources.notes: 2022+ production-worker values are suppressed in the public table; 2021 is the latest complete year.

sources.title: Machinery and equipment price index, by commodity, monthly (Table 18-10-0283-01)
sources.used_for: Escalating 2017 capital-price assumptions to 2026 CAD for logging/construction machinery.
sources.notes: Index level; 2017=100 by table convention. July 2026 is the stable reference month.

sources.title: Machinery and equipment price index, by industry of purchase, monthly (Table 18-10-0284-01)
sources.used_for: Cross-check on the commodity MEPI escalation for forestry and logging purchases.

sources.title: For-hire motor carrier freight services price index, monthly (Table 18-10-0281-01)
sources.used_for: Plausibility check on nominal truck-haul cost growth; not a direct model input.
sources.notes: Used only in the summary cross-check, not in the cost equations.

sources.title: BC VRI 2025 forest and THLB area weights (derived aggregate)
sources.used_for: Forest area by ecoprovince and species-group composition; regional slope weighting.
sources.notes: The raw VRI geodatabase is not redistributed; only the committed aggregate is read.

sources.title: NRCan MRDEM-30 terrain slope screen (derived 960 m aggregate)
sources.used_for: BC regional slope distributions and slope-class weights.
sources.notes: 960 m screening surface, not a 30 m operability classification.

sources.title: National Road Network, British Columbia (derived road-distance classes)
sources.used_for: Context for the haul-distance scenario range; not a direct distance input.
sources.notes: Public roads only; resource and winter roads are absent.

sources.title: Machine rate estimates and equipment utilization - a modified approach
sources.used_for: Machine-rate equation, utilization-adjusted machine life, and worked example.
sources.notes: Open-access CC BY article; equations and worked example are reproducible.

sources.title: Determining fixed and operating costs of logging equipment
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, North Central Forest Experiment Station
sources.used_for: Original fixed/operating cost identities, average annual investment, and worked example.
sources.notes: General Technical Report NC-55; U.S. Government work.

parameters.equation_or_value: CYCLE = 1 km in-block loaded/empty + road loaded/empty + delay + load/unload; cost = (truck+trailer PMH) x CYCLE / payload x (1+support)
parameters.base: 55/65 km/h road; 1.30 h delay; 0.50 h load/unload; 50 m3 payload
parameters.notes: Public-road speed and payload are explicit assumptions; no CVSE or proprietary truck specification is used.

parameters.equation_or_value: dispatch, road management and schedule support add-on
parameters.notes: Explicit assumption.

parameters.equation_or_value: MEPI logging/construction/mining machinery, July 2026, 2017=100
parameters.notes: Index is a StatCan aggregate; the 2017 base price is an assumption.

parameters.equation_or_value: Felling: piece x 3600/(14+26 x piece) x 0.80; skidder: payload/turn x turns/hour x 0.85; processor: piece x 3600/(16+30 x piece) x 0.80; yarder: payload/turn x turns/hour x 0.75; loader: 2.2 m3/0.025 h x 0.90
parameters.notes: Engineering cycle-time assumptions, not BC empirical calibration.

comparison.statement: 756 overlapping scenarios were matched; the median strict/reference ratio is 1.208 and the median delta is +11.21 CAD/m3. This is a cross-check, not calibration and not an input.

limitations: Engineering proxy, not an observed contractor cost.
No BC empirical calibration of productivity, utilization or capital price.
2017 capital prices are assumptions escalated with StatCan MEPI.
Wage base is a midpoint of two broad StatCan wage anchors, not a BC logging wage survey.
Diesel is a retail pump price including taxes.
Zone labels are administrative; the six Interior zones share regional parameters because no strict-open BCTS-zone crosswalk was identified.
Helicopter logging is outside the model boundary.
Road, bridge, silviculture, sorting, barge/rail and tenure costs are excluded.
Low/high columns stack favourable or unfavourable parameter draws; they are a stress envelope, not a confidence interval.
The comparison model is public-reference copyrighted and is used only as a cross-check.
non_claims: Not a mill settlement or profit.
Not a stumpage rate, AAC, tenure, or legal determination.
